en: Added a cost report to the Claude apps gateway admin API, `GET /v1/organizations/analytics/cost`, for reading past spend over a date range in total, per developer, per day or per IdP group
zh: 在 Claude apps gateway 管理 API 中新增成本报告 `GET /v1/organizations/analytics/cost`，可按日期范围读取历史支出，支持总计、按开发者、按天或按 IdP 组统计
